descriptionChirho: All three clusters denote the single adjectival concept of ritual or moral uncleanness/impurity. The multilingual evidence is consistent throughout: English 'unclean / unclean things / impure person', Spanish 'inmundo / inmundas / impuro' (all 'unclean/impure'), Arabic 'نجس / نجاسات / نجس' (unclean / uncleannesses / unclean), Korean '더러운 / 더러운 것들을 / 더러운 자나' (unclean / unclean things / unclean person), Hindi 'अशुद्ध' across all three clusters, and Swahili 'mchafu / uchafu / mchafu' (dirty/unclean / dirtiness / dirty). The differences are purely morphological (singular, plural neuter substantive, singular masculine substantive) and do not represent distinct lexicographic senses.
